definitions.title: Window close behavior
definitions.description: Choose whether closing the window leaves work running or stops after checkpointing.

definitions.title: Default Project parent directory
definitions.description: Default directory used when creating Projects.

definitions.title: Maximum agent spawn depth
definitions.description: Maximum number of nested agent delegation levels.

definitions.title: Maximum concurrent agents per Project
definitions.description: Maximum number of agents that can work concurrently on one Project.

definitions.title: Access mode
definitions.description: Controls how tool operations are authorized.

definitions.title: Allowed restricted-mode side effects
definitions.description: Side-effect categories permitted without an explicit tool allowlist.

definitions.title: Allowed restricted-mode tools
definitions.description: Tool ID globs permitted while access is restricted.

definitions.title: Approval timeout (minutes)
definitions.description: How long approval requests remain pending.

definitions.title: Automatic routing quality policy
definitions.description: Select the quality, balance, or cost priority for automatic model routing.

definitions.title: Decision assistance mode
definitions.description: Off makes no calls. Shadow records task and model advice without changing dispatch. Assist uses confident advice inside the existing eligible model pool; never changes task type or permissions.

definitions.title: Decision provider account
definitions.description: Provider account ID for an independently running typed decision server. Empty disables assessment. Credentials remain in the provider credential store.

definitions.title: Decision model identifier
definitions.description: Explicit server model identifier; this judge is never Auto-routed. Pin a model revision when probability thresholds depend on it.

definitions.title: Typed decision protocol
definitions.description: System One targets local Kev/Laya-compatible /v1/systemone. OpenRouter Decisions targets /api/alpha/decisions.

definitions.title: Allow remote decision inference
definitions.description: Explicitly permit non-loopback HTTPS decision endpoints. Task summaries and eligible candidate metadata leave this machine; a privacy judge cannot undo that disclosure.

definitions.title: Decision request timeout (ms)
definitions.description: Deadline for the complete decision response. Failure keeps deterministic routing; no automatic retry.

definitions.title: Decision probability threshold
definitions.description: Minimum selected-option or yes probability for advice. Not the provider confidence field and not a calibration guarantee. Evaluate on your own tasks.

definitions.title: Model recommendation probability margin
definitions.description: Minimum selected-option probability minus the runner-up for an assisted model recommendation. Permissions, candidate eligibility, manual choice, and budget filters remain authoritative.

definitions.title: Maximum routing latency (ms)
definitions.description: Set zero for no maximum latency constraint.

definitions.title: Model exploration rate
definitions.description: Probability of exploring a less-observed eligible model.

definitions.title: Daily model exploration budget (USD)
definitions.description: Maximum daily spend on exploration picks.

definitions.title: Maximum cost per task (USD)
definitions.description: Maximum model spend allowed for a single task.

definitions.title: Maximum skill catalog entries
definitions.description: Maximum number of eligible skills shown before search is needed.

definitions.title: Scan compatible skill directories
definitions.description: Offer skills discovered in compatible agent-tool directories for trusted Projects.

definitions.title: Maximum skill archive size (MiB)
definitions.description: Maximum compressed archive size accepted by the skill installer.

definitions.title: Maximum extracted skill size (MiB)
definitions.description: Maximum total extracted size accepted by the skill installer.

definitions.title: Maximum files in a skill archive
definitions.description: Maximum number of files extracted by the skill installer.

definitions.title: Allow unisolated plugins in Full access
definitions.description: Permit plugin workers without OS isolation only for Projects in Full access mode.

definitions.title: Maximum plugin worker restarts
definitions.description: Maximum automatic restart attempts after a plugin worker crashes.

definitions.title: Stop idle plugin workers after (minutes)
definitions.description: Idle duration before a plugin worker is stopped; zero disables idle stopping.

definitions.title: Start enabled plugins automatically
definitions.description: Start enabled plugin workers when a Project is opened.

definitions.title: Connect enabled MCP servers automatically
definitions.description: Automatically connect enabled platform and Project MCP connections.

definitions.title: MCP reconnection backoff (seconds)
definitions.description: Delay before retrying a disconnected MCP connection.

definitions.title: Board audit interval (minutes)
definitions.description: Interval for the board-maintainer model pool to audit open threads and decisions.

definitions.title: Archive resolved threads after (days)
definitions.description: Age after which resolved threads are summarized and archived with their history retained.

definitions.title: Minimum thread messages for audit
definitions.description: Only open threads with at least this many messages are sent for maintenance audit.

definitions.title: Maximum decision sync attempts
definitions.description: Maximum automatic retries for a binding decision canon synchronization.

definitions.title: Allow permanent board deletion
definitions.description: Allow permanent thread deletion; otherwise board history may only be archived.

definitions.title: Enable board maintenance
definitions.description: Enable scheduled board-maintainer audits and archive cleanup.

definitions.title: Enable semantic vector search
definitions.description: Enable the configured vector-store adapter for semantic retrieval.

definitions.title: Encrypt backups
definitions.description: Encrypted by default; disabling is not recommended.

definitions.title: Log retention (days)
definitions.description: Number of days to retain service logs.

definitions.title: Engine operation timeout (seconds)
definitions.description: Maximum time an engine process may run before it is terminated.

definitions.title: Automatically detect engine installations
definitions.description: Detect engine executables from environment paths and common installation directories.

definitions.title: Post engine version mismatches to the board
definitions.description: Post one finding to the Engine board thread when the detected version changes out of compatibility.

definitions.title: Vector store kind
definitions.description: Select lancedb, qdrant, a registered adapter ID, or none for lexical-only search.

definitions.title: Vector store deployment
definitions.description: LanceDB is embedded. Qdrant supports managed-local, existing local, remote, or legacy external endpoints.

definitions.title: Allow remote vector storage
definitions.description: Allow embeddings and indexed source metadata to leave this machine. Remote endpoints require HTTPS.

definitions.title: Vector store URL
definitions.description: Base URL for the Qdrant vector store.

definitions.title: Vector store credential reference
definitions.description: Optional reference to an encrypted credential in the platform credential store.

definitions.title: Vector store collection prefix
definitions.description: Prefix used for Project-isolated Qdrant collections.

definitions.title: Vector store timeout (ms)
definitions.description: Request timeout for the configured vector store.

definitions.title: Embedding batch size
definitions.description: Number of new chunks embedded in one provider request.

definitions.title: Knowledge reconcile interval (minutes)
definitions.description: Periodic full reconciliation interval for Project knowledge indexes.

definitions.title: Index Project code
definitions.description: Include allowlisted source files under game/ in the knowledge index.

definitions.title: Index discussion board
definitions.description: Include board threads and messages in the knowledge index.

definitions.title: Indexed code extensions
definitions.description: Allowlisted text/source extensions indexed from game/. Binary assets are never indexed as content.

definitions.title: Asset job poll interval (seconds)
definitions.description: Default delay between polling external asset generation jobs.

definitions.title: Maximum asset download size (MB)
definitions.description: Reject provider output downloads larger than this limit.

definitions.title: Generated asset import directory
definitions.description: Project-relative destination directory for approved generated assets.

definitions.title: External asset authoring command
definitions.description: Optional executable used to open assets in an authoring tool.

definitions.title: Asset preview cache size (MB)
definitions.description: Maximum disk space used by disposable asset preview derivatives.

definitions.title: Asset provider request timeout (ms)
definitions.description: Timeout applied to external asset provider API requests.

definitions.title: Backup exclusion patterns
definitions.description: Additional simple glob patterns excluded from Project backups.

definitions.title: Include generated asset jobs
definitions.description: Include downloaded provider artifacts under .gamecrafter/asset-jobs in Project backups.

definitions.title: Backup compression level
definitions.description: Gzip compression level used for backup archives.

definitions.title: Backup secret KDF cost
definitions.description: Scrypt logN used to protect recovery identities.

definitions.title: Drill after backup
definitions.description: Decrypt and hash-check each new archive before retention runs.

definitions.title: Backup staging directory
definitions.description: Optional directory for encrypted archive staging; empty uses the profile cache.

definitions.title: Maximum archive size (MB)
definitions.description: Zero means unlimited; otherwise fail before upload when the archive exceeds this size.

definitions.title: DCC executable search paths
definitions.description: Additional directories to scan for DCC executables.

definitions.title: DCC operation timeout (seconds)
definitions.description: Maximum time a headless DCC operation may run before termination.

definitions.title: Automatically detect DCC installations
definitions.description: Detect DCC executables from PATH, common locations, and supported WSL interop paths.

definitions.title: Allow unrestricted DCC scripts
definitions.description: Allow DCC run-script calls containing subprocess or destructive filesystem operations.

definitions.title: DCC render preview resolution
definitions.description: Resolution in pixels for generated DCC preview renders.

definitions.title: Automatic integration policy
definitions.description: Control whether validated, conflict-free worktree changes are integrated automatically.

definitions.title: Resource lock timeout (seconds)
definitions.description: Time before an unrenewed resource lock expires.

definitions.title: Worktree directory
definitions.description: Project-relative directory used for isolated task worktrees.

definitions.title: Impact confidence threshold
definitions.description: Impact paths below this confidence need explicit validation.

definitions.title: Optional agent context ceiling
definitions.description: Zero uses selected-model capacity automatically. A positive value explicitly lowers the estimated input allowance, including messages and tool schemas; it cannot raise the model limit.

definitions.title: Default agent turn limit
definitions.description: Default maximum model turns for roles without max-turns.

definitions.title: Check for updates on startup
definitions.description: Check the stable release channel after the Control Room starts.

definitions.title: Stable releases URL
definitions.description: GitHub latest-release API URL or a direct gamecrafter-release.json URL.

definitions.title: Download updates automatically
definitions.description: Download a compatible release after checking; installation always remains user-controlled.

definitions.title: Update check interval (hours)
definitions.description: Interval between background stable-channel checks.

definitions.title: Release signing public key
definitions.description: Ed25519 public key used to verify the detached release checksum signature.
